ticket.title: Incremental compilation was never disabled: [env] CARGO_INCREMENTAL is invisible to cargo
ticket.description: The .cargo/config.toml file sets CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 under [env], but [env] only populates the environment of the processes cargo spawns (rustc, build scripts); cargo reads CARGO_INCREMENTAL from its own process environment, so incremental compilation stayed on and target/debug/incremental refilled to 1.3 GB in a single session. Measured on this machine: cargo check -p storypole-core after touching lib.rs wrote 4.1 MB of incremental artefacts in 1.67 s; with [build] incremental = false it wrote 0 B in 3.90 s. The disk risk is real (ENOSPC has broken the tool layer twice) and the 2.2 s cost is per-crate recheck, absorbed by sccache on the dependency graph.

verification_receipt.summary: incremental dir stays 0B after touching lib.rs and cargo check; 3.90s vs 1.67s recorded; numbers in commit, CONTRIBUTING 1.4 and GB-187
